[EVENT] User expressed interest in keeping kids occupied during long drives.

[FACT] User is interested in seeing geysers and hot springs during their trip to Yellowstone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed Old Faithful as a must-see and recommended other geysers: Grand Geyser, Castle Geyser, and Daisy Geyser.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended hot springs: Mammoth Hot Springs, Norris Geyser Basin, and Boiling River.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for spotting bears in Yellowstone: know the habitats, look early morning and late evening, keep a safe distance, look for signs, and drive slowly while scanning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant identified best areas to spot bears: Lamar Valley, Slough Creek, Tower-Roosevelt Area, and Mammoth Hot Springs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested bringing binoculars, keeping a safe distance from wildlife, being patient, and considering guided tours for wildlife viewing.  
[FACT] User is interested in exploring the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone River.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone River as a must-see and provided hiking trail recommendations: Brink of Lower Falls Trail, Seven Mile Hole Trail, and South Rim Trail.
